title: AMU Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 03 Assistant Professor Posts
description: The Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 03 Assistant Professor Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their post-graduation and Ph.D. can apply for the AMU Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply in online mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection proces, application fee...
